summary: Retest of the 4-criterion briefing (vendor sidebar firm-identity bug fix, dashboard subtitle firm identity, admin identity unaffected, login-error vendor-code-rule bug fix). Backend suite grew from 26 to 28 passing tests (added test_tscheck_login_error_vendor_code_rule.py). Added 4 new browser checks for the new criteria, all passing. Re-ran all 9 pre-existing browser checks by name: 8 passed clean, admin-create-user-flow failed once on a toast-overlay pointer-interception timing issue and passed clean on immediate rerun -> classified flaky, not a bug (pre-existing check, unrelated to this change set). No bugs found.

Immediate rerun: passed clean, user created then deleted successfully. Classified flaky per rerun-before-classify rule; not counted as failed/bug.
